name: uuid-shortener
description: UUID compression helper converting standard 36-char UUIDs to short URL-safe Base62 22-char strings and back.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when generating compact database identifiers, shortening URLs with keys, saving log files storage size, or reducing API request payloads widths. Import using: import { shortenUuid, expandUuid } from './crypto/uuid-shortener.js';

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Standard UUID string sequence to compress.
